body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1489

## Summary
The supplied `test_run` claim detail (DCP-V1-210) carries only `outcome`, `run`, `origin`, `revision` and `at`. Run ledgers used to decide whether a test is trustworthy also record retries, a same-revision flake verdict, cleanup outcome, a control (negative) run outcome and per-axis validity results. These fit only in free text. In addition, supplied gaps must name a subject, so a gap about one run (flaky, stale evidence) has to be attached to the run's parent subject and loses its target.

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d.
- Producer data: 1,993 runs, 9,965 per-run validity rows (5 axes each), 2,274 run-level gaps.

## Reproduction
1. Provider: flow `p:flow:a`; claim `p:run:1` on it with `{"test_run": {"outcome": "passed", "run": "r1", "origin": "supplied", "retries": 2}}` -> refused (unknown field).
2. Supplied gap `{"id": "p:gap:1", "subject": "p:run:1", "kind": "flaky", ...}` -> refused `supplied gap subject missing` (a claim is not a subject).

## Measured
All 1,993 runs import with outcome only; retries, flake verdict, cleanup and control outcome survive only as text; 9,965 validity rows have no home; 2,274 run gaps were re-attached to the flow.

## Expected
- Optional closed fields on `test_run`: `retries` (int >= 0), `flake_verdict` (`stable flaky unqualified unknown`), `cleanup` (`passed failed partial not-run unknown`), `control_outcome` (outcome vocabulary), and `validity: [{axis, status}]` with closed axis and status sets.
- A supplied gap may target a claim id (or a run id declared by a `test_run` detail).
- `docs_coverage` can count runs by flake verdict and cleanup; supplied fields still grant no trust.

## Acceptance tests
- A run with all new fields builds and round-trips through `docs_get`.
- Unknown values are refused.
- A gap targeting a run claim appears in `docs_gaps` for that claim and for its subject.
